_comment: 10 clean DEMO one-bedroom rentals in Chisinau for the cold-start showcase board. Owner directive 17.10: drop the third-party (Acces Imobil) listings and their watermarked photos entirely; show a small, tidy, LEGAL demo board instead. Every card here is is_demo=1, carries a '🧪 Демо' chip in the bot and Mini App, and uses a reserved fake phone (079 9xx xxx) so nobody is pretended to be reachable and no real contact is leaked. Photos are generated (images/demoNN.jpg), not scraped. Prices are plausible Chisinau one-bedroom rents (EUR). Real owner ads appear on the same board the moment people start posting and are NOT marked demo.
